schemaNote: Phase 0 seed for BookBookKit's bundled PriceList.json (architecture.md §7.10). Image-model output-token counts are measured (SP-2, SP-6); per-token prices are the architecture's published figures, which the measured costs matched. Text/vision per-token prices are placeholders used only by LiveSpendGuard and must be checked against OpenAI's pricing page in Phase 9.

estimation.notes: Output tokens are not proportional to pixel count (low 1024x1536 < low 1024x1024), so only interpolate within one quality and aspect class; prefer measured entries. Input-image tokens are measured at three sizes. They fit "downscale to <= 512 px a side, then 1 token per 16x16 patch" (hypothesis; Phase 9 measures a 1536x1024 reference).
